posts.title: 2 Chennai Engineers Helped 130+ Buildings Save 5 Billion Litres of Water by Spotting Hidden Leaks.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: Chennai startup EarthFokus has helped over 130 commercial buildings save more than five billion litres of water, by spotting hidden leaks and cutting everyday waste.

posts.title: A Crane, a Duck & a Bird From the Arctic: What Happens When India's Wetlands Disappear?
posts.author: Sriroopa Dutta
posts.text: India's new Red List assessment examines 1,211 bird species. Explore what the proposed conservation status of the Marbled Duck, Grey Plover and Sarus Crane reveals about wetland conservation.

posts.title: Pollution Is Rising. Here’s How to Choose the Right Air Purifier for Your Home.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: Buying an air purifier this winter? Learn what HEPA filters mean, how they work and 5 things to check before choosing one for your home.

posts.title: Her Daughter Had Type 1 Diabetes at 2. This Mother's One Rule Was to Never Let It Limit Her.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: Kiara Powar was diagnosed with Type 1 diabetes at two. Discover how her parents helped her pursue badminton and become a sports presenter.

posts.title: 33 Villagers Are Training to Keep People & Tigers Safe When Their Paths Cross in the Sundarbans.
posts.author: Sriroopa Dutta
posts.text: Primary Response Teams in the Sundarbans train local residents to respond to tiger sightings, share safety advice and support forest officials during emergencies.

posts.title: 10 Million Hectares of Sal Forests: 7 Ways One Tree Supports India’s Rural Economy.
posts.author: Raajwrita Dutta
posts.text: What makes India’s sal tree so valuable? Look beyond its timber to understand the many ways this forest species influences everyday life.

posts.title: How an Assam Father & Daughter Are Making Notebooks From Rhino Dung to Help Villagers Earn.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: Discover how Assam's Mahesh Bora and his daughter turn elephant and rhino dung into handmade paper, creating rural jobs and reducing reliance on wood pulp.

posts.title: Why Do Jaipur’s Streets Run in Straight Lines? A King & a Scholar Planned It 300 Years Ago.
posts.author: Avantika Krishna
posts.text: Jaipur predates Google Maps by 278 years, yet its nine sectors and right-angled streets still define the walled city. Water shortages and a scholar king drove the plan.

posts.title: Moustache Contests, Decorated Camels & Village Games: What Awaits You at Pushkar Fair 2026.
posts.author: Sriroopa Dutta
posts.text: Pushkar Fair 2026 runs from 17 to 24 November. Find out which cultural contests, village games and local crafts make this Rajasthan celebration memorable for visitors.

posts.title: To Help Rajasthan Students Struggling With Maths, This IAS Officer Brought AI Tutors to 353 Schools.
posts.author: Avantika Krishna
posts.text: Rajasthan’s Tonk recorded a 96.4% mathematics pass rate in 2025. An AI-powered initiative by IAS officer Saumya Jha is helping government school students tackle maths anxiety.

posts.title: Delhi’s AQI Has Crossed 300. What Does It Mean for Your Balcony Garden?
posts.author: Raajwrita Dutta
posts.text: Can balcony plants withstand Delhi’s polluted air? Understand how particulate matter affects plant health and what gardeners should consider during winter.

posts.title: This Scientist Showed a Goa Town How to Turn 1 Tonne of Kitchen Scraps Into Compost in 2 Days.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: See how kitchen waste composting works in Bicholim, Goa, from sorting and shredding food scraps to the role that microbes and added air play as the scraps break down.

posts.title: Why Does Winter Fog Blanket Delhi but Rarely Bengaluru? The Science Behind India’s Changing Morning Skies.
posts.author: Sriroopa Dutta
posts.text: Why does Delhi experience frequent winter fog while Bengaluru sees far fewer fog events? Explore the science behind India's regional fog patterns, from the Indo-Gangetic Plains to the Deccan Plateau.

posts.title: Stuck in Bengaluru Traffic Again? Now a Digital Twin of the City Could Cut Travel Time by 30%.
posts.author: Vaishali Gautam
posts.text: Bharat1.ai wants to build a computer model of how people move through Bengaluru. By bringing road, bus and Metro data together, it hopes to show where journeys repeatedly slow down and give planners a way to compare possible fixes.

posts.title: A Premature Birth, 35 Lakh in Medical Bills & Months of Care: How This Bengaluru Baby Pulled Through.
posts.author: Nishtha Kawrani
posts.text: Baby tracheostomy care changed life for Bengaluru parents Gouthami and Sharan. After months of home care, their daughter Chikoo's tube was removed.
